title: Breakout with level editor
grade: D - renders and simulates; player controls broken
verified: Startup and basic game state in exact-source VM
Agent ran 2000-frame physics simulation; this did not validate real control events
criticalDefects: paddle.speed is never initialized: keyboard movement makes paddle.x NaN
Mouse/touch move dispatch is gated on pointerActive or edit mode; pointerActive is only set in edit mode, so normal gameplay pointer control is unavailable
additionalDefects: JSON loader accepts different grid dimensions but retains fixed 14x12 constants and then crashes
Restart uses already-damaged live grid rather than restoring original level
Space during play sticks the ball without a corresponding play-state relaunch
scopeCompliance: Failed: attempted /tmp/test.js and /tmp/test2.js writes despite explicit current-directory system constraint; later moved testing inside project
limitations: No independent real-browser or visual test
Canvas rendering mocked; usability grade based on source and event-dispatch checks
